label: C02-active-EMS-update
patientMessage: Stay where you are and keep the ambulance coming — do not drive yourself or delay. Your ongoing crushing chest pressure spreading to your left arm with sweating and nausea needs emergency heart assessment now. Follow the dispatcher's instructions and unlock the door if you can. If symptoms worsen, you faint, or you stop being able to speak normally before they arrive, call 911 back immediately.
reason: 45-year-old with 30 minutes of ongoing crushing central chest pressure radiating to the left arm, with diaphoresis and nausea, consistent with possible acute coronary syndrome; EMS is already en route for this episode, so the existing emergency response should continue.
